title: EncounterCatalog
description: Version 2: an enemy group on a visible turn timeline (decision 0006), placed on a 3 × 3 grid per side (decision 0014; all grid fields are optional). The party comes from the game's roster (party.json, M5.4d) plus any guests; an encounter may instead author its own fixed party.

party.description: A fixed party for this fight only, instead of the roster. Leave it out to use the game's party roster.

guests.description: Fighters who join the roster's party for this fight only (decision 0014 M5.4d). A guest's cell is preferred; if a member stands there, the guest takes the first free cell (front column top to bottom, then the middle, then the back).

opening.description: How the fight opens (decision 0014). back-attack: the enemy attacks the party from its rear. pincer: enemies on both sides; each enemy then needs a flank. Default normal.

cell.description: Grid cell (decision 0014). lane: 1 top to 3 bottom; depth: 1 front to 3 back. A side places all its fighters or none; unplaced sides fill the front column top to bottom, then the middle, then the back. A big enemy's cell is its top front corner.

size.description: Enemies only: how many lanes and depths a big enemy covers. Default 1 × 1.

reach.description: melee: front-facing targets only; reach (spears, whips, polearms): one layer deeper; ranged (bows, spells): anyone. Default melee.

creature.description: Enemies only: a Stone Soup monster ID from assets/source/creatures/stone-soup (decision 0015). The battle draws it animated with its assigned motion; frame stays the fallback if the creature art cannot load.

faces.description: Which way the creature art faces. The battle mirrors it to face the party. Default left.

flank.description: Pincer encounters only, and required there: which side of the party this enemy attacks from. Each flank has its own grid.
